text: first release. ggmira draws multilayer networks MiRA, browser-based multilayer network visualizer, ggplot2-like syntax: start network mira() add components +. Elements: mira_node(), mira_intralayer(), mira_interlayer() mira_layer() map colors sizes data’s attributes, set constants, shapes names. Bipartite networks take settings per node set. Scales: color_scale, color_values, color_palette, color_reverse color_limits element (?mira_scales). Layout, camera legends: mira_layout(), mira_camera(), mira_legends(). Filters: mira_filter() draws nodes, links layers. Views: plot can open MiRA’s views: mira_mode_grid(), mira_mode_map(), mira_mode_layer(), mira_mode_meta(), mira_mode_dashboard(), mira_mode_data(). Files: mira_save() saves plot PNG, JPG PDF file, without opening window. Back R: MiRA’s R button gives ggmira code view screen, changes made MiRA included. Help: mira_options() lists component can set network; mira_spec() shows plot sends MiRA. Opening: browser RStudio’s Viewer pane (print(p, viewer = TRUE)); plot_mira() opens network MiRA’s defaults. Feedback: mira_feedback() documentation’s Feedback buttons open filled-GitHub issue. MiRA: bundles MiRA 1.2, one later change: RStudio’s Viewer pane, MiRA’s top bar keeps lab logo, leaving room plot.
